patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width light and dark backgrounds, often employing a two-column split for content blocks, creating clear visual separation and rhythm.

Hero typography uses a highly stylized, almost pixelated or glitch-art inspired font with mixed case and specific color accents, contrasting sharply with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and even smaller monospace labels.
A high-contrast palette of off-white and deep charcoal dominates, punctuated by vibrant, specific accent colors (pink, green, yellow) used sparingly for emphasis on key words or elements.
No scroll-triggered motion was observable from the provided scroll sequence due to an application error. The homepage hero section features an autoplaying video.
Product listings on the 'Store' page are presented in a dense, uniform grid with minimal text, prioritizing visual display of the items over detailed descriptions.

technique_notes: The site employs a stark contrast between large, expressive display typography and small, understated body text to establish a strong visual hierarchy and unique brand impact.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating full-width light and dark background colors, often utilizing a two-column layout to pair text with a visual element like a video or image.

While no scroll-triggered motion was observable from the provided sequence, the detected animation technologies (GSAP, CSS keyframes) suggest the potential for sophisticated reveal animations or interactive elements as the user scrolls. The hero section incorporates an autoplaying video for dynamic visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, distinctive display headings (~6-8x body) with small, understated sans-serif body text and even smaller monospace labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy in hero and main content sections, providing ample whitespace, but becoming denser in product grids to maximize item display.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost glitch-art inspired hero typography, which immediately communicates a unique and experimental design ethos. This strong typographic identity, combined with a high-contrast, minimalist layout, sets it apart from typical agency sites.
